title: Visual object ERP EEG dataset (Kaneshiro et al. 2015)
description: A visual event-related potential dataset of 124-channel EEG recorded from 10 healthy participants viewing photographs from six object categories (human body, human face, animal body, animal face, fruit/vegetable, inanimate object). It contains 5,184 trials, with 72 images per category shown for 500 ms with a 750 ms interstimulus interval. The data support research on neural object representations through single-trial EEG classification and representational similarity analysis, and are distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was acquired with a 124-channel EGI Net Amps 300 system and HydroCel Geodesic Sensor Net (GSN-HydroCel-128), sampled at 62.5 Hz with average reference. Participants viewed 72 photographs per category from six object categories, each shown for 500 ms with a 750 ms interstimulus interval. Data were preprocessed and organized in BIDS format.
